REMIELLE-REFRINGE.title: Refringe (Attribute Anomaly)
REMIELLE-REFRINGE.description: Deal 4 [purple]Anomaly Damage[/purple], and increase the [red]Debuff[/red] that triggered this [purple]Anomaly[/purple] by 1 stack.
REMIELLE-PHASEFLOW.title: Phase Flow
REMIELLE-PHASEFLOW.description: At the end of your turn, if this card is still in your [gold]Hand[/gold], play it automatically.
REMIELLE-DANCESTEP.title: Dance Step
REMIELLE-DANCESTEP.description: Whenever this card is drawn into your [gold]Hand[/gold], trigger its [gold]Dance Step[/gold].
REMIELLE-FEATHER.title: Feather
REMIELLE-FEATHER.description: When played, deal 2 damage to a random enemy. For each [gold]Feather[/gold] card played this turn, increase this damage by 1.
